desc: TC-SEC-01: Login Email input field sanitization check against standard SQL injection patterns
expected: Application sanitizes input or safely handles single quote sequences

desc: TC-SEC-02: Dashboard search box query sanitization check against inline comment characters
expected: Search query drops comment blocks (--) to prevent database parsing errors

desc: TC-SEC-03: Transaction Description parameter validator check against SELECT union query commands
expected: SELECT UNION query patterns in transaction description are blocked

desc: TC-SEC-04: API endpoint parameter check against malicious UPDATE database commands
expected: Transaction update parameters are isolated and cannot modify tables structure

desc: TC-SEC-05: Stored XSS check on Transaction Description inputs HTML characters escaping
expected: HTML elements are escaped and render as literal text, not HTML nodes

desc: TC-SEC-06: Reflective XSS check on URL query variables parameters parsing
expected: Reflected query parameters from URL string are parsed and encoded

desc: TC-SEC-07: File Upload XSS checks on Profile Avatar filename string characters
expected: Avatar filename strings remove non-alphanumeric tag characters

desc: TC-SEC-08: Stored XSS check on Profile Display Name text input field
expected: Display Name input encodes brackets to prevent arbitrary script injections

desc: TC-SEC-09: Verify presence of Anti-CSRF verification tokens inside sensitive form nodes
expected: Forms submit payloads include active unique CSRF session hashes

desc: TC-SEC-10: Verify Anti-CSRF verification tokens on Transaction logging POST requests
expected: POST requests without valid CSRF security tokens return 403 Forbidden status

desc: TC-SEC-11: Verify SameSite attributes configuration parameters on session authentication cookies
expected: Cookies have SameSite=Lax or SameSite=Strict to defend against CSRF

desc: TC-SEC-12: JWT signature key validity validation constraint checks
expected: JWT tokens with altered payload contents return invalid signature key errors

desc: TC-SEC-13: JWT Expiry token claim verification check
expected: Expired JWT tokens are rejected and client redirects to sign-in

desc: TC-SEC-14: JWT Algorithm validation (rejecting "none" algorithm) constraints
expected: JWT authorization rejects Alg: "none" configurations to prevent signature bypass

desc: TC-SEC-15: Session Token token blocklist revocation validation check on Logout
expected: Logged-out session tokens are added to revocation blocklist and rendered inactive

desc: TC-SEC-16: Inactive Session Timeout expiration limits checks
expected: Inactivity over 15 minutes invalidates session token automatically

desc: TC-SEC-17: Concurrent User Sessions limits bounds checks
expected: User accounts exceed sessions limit block subsequent connections attempts

desc: TC-SEC-18: Secure and HttpOnly cookie attributes check on Session Cookies
expected: Auth cookies utilize Secure and HttpOnly flags to block scripting access

desc: TC-SEC-19: Email address syntax validation format checking regex rules
expected: Incorrect email formatting does not match registration criteria

desc: TC-SEC-20: Transaction amount inputs negative numeric values validation
expected: Transaction form validates amount bounds and rejects negative entries

desc: TC-SEC-21: Transaction Date limits and bounds range checks validation
expected: Dates set beyond maximum future bounds are rejected

desc: TC-SEC-22: X-Frame-Options: DENY clickjacking headers verification check
expected: Server returns X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN header configurations

desc: TC-SEC-23: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers verification check
expected: CSP header blocks execution of external script elements

desc: TC-SEC-24: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers check
expected: Nosniff headers prevent browsers from executing script MIME type spoofing

desc: TC-SEC-25: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) headers verification check
expected: Server returns HSTS headers forcing browser redirects to HTTPS protocol

desc: TC-SEC-26: API keys and client access rate limiting checking
expected: API rate limit blocks traffic exceeding 100 requests per minute

desc: TC-SEC-27: Unauthenticated client requests blocks on private API endpoints
expected: Requests without valid Authorization tokens fail with 401 Unauthorized

desc: TC-SEC-28: Authorization header Bearer token schema formatting validation
expected: Improperly formatted Authorization header formats fail schema checks

desc: TC-SEC-29: Access-Control-Allow-Origin wildcard denial for credentialed cross-origin requests
expected: Server restricts CORS credentials access when wildcard is used

desc: TC-SEC-30: Verify CORS preflight headers Access-Control-Allow-Origin checks on sensitive endpoints
expected: Sensitive API endpoints restrict access to specific trusted domains and reject * wildcards
